results.description:
The superstar virtual cat is going on the ultimate pet adventure, and with you, it's going to be more fun than ever! Your favorite funny friend is ready to dazzle you with his new wardrobe, amazing skills, and special features.

What You Can Do:

- Learn New Skills: Teach Tom cool tricks and skills like playing drums, basketball, and boxing. He'll be the most talented cat around!

- Taste the Latest Snacks: Discover and feed Tom various delicious and funny snacks. From ice cream to sushi, Tom loves it all! Do you dare to give him a hot chili pepper?

- Stay Clean: Help Tom stay fresh and clean with fun activities like bathing and brushing his teeth. Keep him squeaky clean!

- Pop to the Toilet: Yes, even Tom needs bathroom breaks, and it's as funny as it sounds! Help him out and make sure he's comfy.

- Explore New Worlds: Travel with Tom to exciting new places and discover hidden surprises. Fly to different islands with special flight tokens!

- Collect Clothes, Furniture, and Special Memories: Customize Tom's look with crazy outfits and decorate his home with funky furniture.

- Gacha Goodies: Unlock awesome rewards and surprises by doing different activities. Get cool outfits, delicious snacks, and more!


Extra Fun Activities:

- Play on Giant Swing and Trampoline: Let Tom swing high and jump around for some extra laughs.

- Cook Smoothies: Blend up delicious and wacky smoothies for Tom to enjoy.

- Heal Booboos: Take care of Tom when he gets hurt and make sure he's back to his playful self in no time.

- Mini Games and Puzzles: Challenge yourself with entertaining mini-games and puzzles that keep you hooked for hours.

- Keep Playing: See how Talking Tom's backyard changes into a Candy Kingdom, Pirate Island, Underwater Home, and other magical worlds, where you can dive into the endless fun with Tom and his pet friends.

This virtual pet game is packed with adventure, laughter, and unforgettable moments! Make sure you capture them all!

results.description:
Welcome to the most fire neighborhood around! My Talking Tom Friends 2 brings together all your favorite friends for a next level virtual pet adventure. Talking Tom, Angela, Hank, Ben, and Becca have all moved into a fun filled new town, and they’re ready to share their world with you. Get to know each character’s unique style, visit their homes, and enjoy endless games and laughter in this vibrant Talking Tom and Friends experience.

Game Features:
Care & Bonding: Take care of Tom and his friends by feeding them, bathing them, and keeping them happy. Play with each pet – toss a ball, give a hug, or play music. They even talk now with their own voices, joking and reacting to make every interaction extra delightful!

Explore & Decorate: Stroll through a lively neighborhood with lots to discover. Each friend has a home you can visit and style them your way. Design Tom’s music loft, Angela’s art studio, Hank’s comfy cabin, Ben’s gadget garage, and Becca’s VR room with hundreds of cool decorations. You can also visit the local food market, clothes shop, or park for more adventures and surprises around town.

Fun & Mini-Games: Find a great set of mini games and activities at every corner! Shoot hoops at the basketball court, race cars (or lawnmowers if that’s your thing), splash some color with spray paint art, craft and fly paper airplanes, play soccer, and much more. There’s always a new game or challenge to master.

Fashion & Style: Dress your friends in the trendiest outfits and let their personalities shine. From funky costumes to cute accessories, there are tons of clothes to mix and match. Give Angela stylish makeovers, put Hank in a funny hat, or try out cool looks for Tom. You’re the stylist – express your creativity!

Cool gadgets & toys: Play with fun gadgets and toys around town. Fly a drone, launch paper planes, test Ben’s inventions, and more. Every friend has unique hobbies – try them and get to know them like never before.

Rewards & Surprises: Daily rewards await. Earn coins and bonuses as you play, and unlock new items, clothes, and decorations to make the game even more exciting. Keep an eye out for special events, gifts, and something new’s always happening in the world of Talking Tom and Friends.

Meet the Gang:
Tom is the playful leader who loves adventures and music. Angela is the creative soul with a flair for fashion. Hank is the chill guy who lives for food and fun. Ben is the genius inventor, always tinkering with a new gadget. And Becca is the bold one, who adds a spark of adrenaline rush to the group. Each friend has a big personality and they all need you to help them live their best lives!

Talking Tom Friends 2: Every day brings fresh adventures and playful moments where fun and endless possibilities await. Experience friendship with Talking Tom, Angela, Hank, Ben, and Becca like never before. Take care of your favorite virtual pets, personalize their houses, and dive into a world full of exciting activities. Ideal for fans of virtual pet sims and anyone seeking exploration and creativity in one game.

From Outfit7, creators of My Talking Tom Friends, My Talking Tom 2, and My Talking Angela 2.

results.description:
Download the legendary game that started it all—Talking Tom Cat!

THE ORIGINAL TALKING VIRTUAL PET
Talking Tom is the talking cat that took the world by storm. He repeats what you say in his hilarious voice, and reacts in surprising (and sometimes strange) ways. Whether you're a longtime fan or new to the chaos, this virtual pet game hits different.

POKE TOM
Can’t stop poking Tom? You’re not alone. Tom might just be the most pokeable animal in the universe.
- Poke Tom’s face and see what happens (spoiler: may become unhinged)
- Tap his belly, his feet, or even pull his tail
- Keep poking and discover hidden reactions

TALK TO THE LEGEND
Tom’s talkback feature made him famous—and it still holds up.
- Talk to Tom and hear him repeat everything you say
- LOL at his NEW voice filters
- Share funny moments with your friends

FEED TOM
This talking cat has a big appetite. And dramatic reactions.
- Feed him spicy chillies and watch him fart fire
- Toss him a watermelon (his favorite!)

SO MANY WAYS TO PLAY
- Pet Tom and hear him purr
- Try poking him 100 times. We dare you
- Make him fart and blame someone else
- Don't talk to him and see what happens

Join a global community of fans creating memes, videos, and challenges with Talking Tom, the cat who talks back, makes you laugh, and somehow always feels like more than a virtual animal. He’s your chaotic little buddy.

Tom is brought to you by Outfit7, the makers of My Talking Tom, Talking Tom Gold Run and My Talking Angela.
